Now Tap That Card

Tap the new card in Your Hand below to open it — then choose Play to add it to your Salo-Salo (or use its power), or Discard to pass on it.

🍲⚡

Two Kinds of Cards

Family, Food & Fun cards go straight into your Salo-Salo when you tap Play — that's how you build toward 5. Action, Sabotage & Kultura cards (like Utang na Loob, or a Guest that steals) do something instead — Play fires off their power on your opponent rather than collecting them. Not sure which one you're holding? The label right under the card art always says.
